description: Search the live catalog of Gameshop Enter — original retro Nintendo games, consoles, PlayStation 4/5 games and Pokémon TCG, all personally tested, shipping to all 27 EU countries plus Monaco. Understands abbreviations ("gba"), Dutch and English game names, typos, and Pokémon version names in German, French, Italian and Spanish ("pokemon feuerrot", "pokémon rubis"). Returns products with price in EUR, stock status, the product-page URL (url) and a direct checkout link (checkoutUrl) that puts the item in the cart and opens checkout.

platform.description: Optional platform filter, e.g. "Game Boy Advance", "N64", "Switch"; abbreviations work too (ds, 3ds, gba, gbc, snes, nes, wii, wii u, gamecube, ps4, ps5, tcg). "ds" means Nintendo DS only (not 3DS), "wii" means Wii only (not Wii U).

query.description: Game title, character, franchise or SKU

name: search_products
